info.title: Redrob Console API for Redrob Design
info.description: Generated from src/app/integrations/console/contract. JSON with camelCase fields, bearer auth, `{ error: code }` failures, Retry-After on 429 and 503, cursor pagination and ETag / If-Match on revisioned resources. Model provider keys never pass through these endpoints.

get.summary: Who this installation is signed in as, its workspaces, and its device key.

200.description: Who this installation is signed in as, its workspaces, and its device key.

put.summary: Register this installation's public key, or replace it.

200.description: Register this installation's public key, or replace it.

get.summary: A workspace: its sources and the policy every member follows.

200.description: A workspace: its sources and the policy every member follows.

get.summary: The workspace Design Memory every model reads before it draws.

200.description: The workspace Design Memory every model reads before it draws.

get.summary: The Redrob Leaderboard picks for designing screens and layouts.

200.description: The Redrob Leaderboard picks for designing screens and layouts.

get.summary: List prices per million tokens, for answer receipts.

200.description: List prices per million tokens, for answer receipts.

post.summary: Watch workspace sources on behalf of a shipped page.

201.description: Watch workspace sources on behalf of a shipped page.

get.summary: Changes in watched sources since a cursor, oldest first.

200.description: Changes in watched sources since a cursor, oldest first.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous call; omit for events from now on

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

get.summary: Saved versions of a document, newest first.

200.description: Saved versions of a document, newest first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

post.summary: Save a version. If-Match carries the last version list ETag the client saw.

201.description: Save a version. If-Match carries the last version list ETag the client saw.

200.description: One version with its snapshot.

patch.summary: Name a version, which also keeps it past retention.

200.description: Name a version, which also keeps it past retention.

get.summary: Every comment on a document, including resolved ones.

200.description: Every comment on a document, including resolved ones.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only comments changed after this time

post.summary: Add a comment or a reply. Repeating the same id is idempotent.

201.description: Add a comment or a reply. Repeating the same id is idempotent.

patch.summary: Edit, move, resolve or reopen a comment.

200.description: Edit, move, resolve or reopen a comment.

delete.summary: Delete a comment and, for the first comment, its thread.

204.description: Delete a comment and, for the first comment, its thread.

post.summary: A short-lived ticket for the collaboration relay WebSocket of one room.

201.description: A short-lived ticket for the collaboration relay WebSocket of one room.

get.summary: Component libraries published to the workspace.

200.description: Component libraries published to the workspace.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

get.summary: A library revision; `latest` names the newest.

200.description: A library revision; `latest` names the newest.

post.summary: Publish a revision. If-Match carries the latest revision ETag; If-None-Match: * for a new library.

201.description: Publish a revision. If-Match carries the latest revision ETag; If-None-Match: * for a new library.

post.summary: Share a file: Console keeps its sealed name and this device’s wrapped key.

201.description: Share a file: Console keeps its sealed name and this device’s wrapped key.

get.summary: Files shared with this person, most recently changed first.

200.description: Files shared with this person, most recently changed first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

get.summary: A shared file and the caller’s role on it.

200.description: A shared file and the caller’s role on it.

parameters.name: X-Redrob-Link
parameters.description: A view link token, instead of the session. Grants viewer access.

patch.summary: Rename a shared file. Editors and owners.

200.description: Rename a shared file. Editors and owners.

delete.summary: Delete a shared file and everything stored for it. Owners only.

204.description: Delete a shared file and everything stored for it. Owners only.

get.summary: Who has access, and who is invited.

200.description: Who has access, and who is invited.

post.summary: Share with an address. Editors and owners.

201.description: Share with an address. Editors and owners.

200.description: Change someone’s role. Owners only.

get.summary: This device’s wrapped copies of the file key.

200.description: This device’s wrapped copies of the file key.

get.summary: Members’ devices still waiting for the file key. Editors and owners.

200.description: Members’ devices still waiting for the file key. Editors and owners.

post.summary: Hand the file key, wrapped, to pending devices.

200.description: Hand the file key, wrapped, to pending devices.

get.summary: Whether the file has a live view link.

200.description: Whether the file has a live view link.

post.summary: Make a new view link, retiring the old one.

201.description: Make a new view link, retiring the old one.

post.summary: A presigned link to upload one sealed snapshot or version.

201.description: A presigned link to upload one sealed snapshot or version.

get.summary: The current sealed snapshot, as a short-lived download link.

200.description: The current sealed snapshot, as a short-lived download link.

parameters.name: X-Redrob-Link
parameters.description: A view link token, instead of the session. Grants viewer access.

put.summary: Commit an uploaded snapshot if nobody has since its base revision.

200.description: Commit an uploaded snapshot if nobody has since its base revision.

post.summary: A one-use ticket for the file’s collaboration room.

201.description: A one-use ticket for the file’s collaboration room.

parameters.name: X-Redrob-Link
parameters.description: A view link token, instead of the session. Grants viewer access.

Error.description: Known codes: unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, conflict, precondition_failed, invalid_request, rate_limited, unavailable.
